title: Horizontal FAQ Navigator
description: A continuous drag-scrollable horizontal track of product information cards with quick answer previews.
heading: Horizontal Product Rail
subtitle: Swipe through key product parameters horizontally.

questions.question: What certified packaging is used for transit?
questions.answer: Shipped inside a 100% recycled FSC-certified rigid gift box with organic cotton dust protection.

questions.question: What is the return window for international orders?
questions.answer: 30 days from delivery date with pre-printed customs return documentation included.

questions.question: Does the garment include a custom garment bag?
questions.answer: Every coat includes a heavy-duty organic canvas suit carrier with dual carry handles.

questions.question: How are leather trims protected during air transit?
questions.answer: Leather accents are wrapped in custom acid-free tissue paper and protective foam covers.
